correctness.rationale: For any weighted forest with nonzero edge weights over any field, leaf v adjacent to u yields a nonzero 2x2 alternating block via congruence, leaving F minus {u,v}; rank therefore recurses by +2. A maximum matching can be chosen using uv, so nu(F) recurses by +1; rank=2nu(F) follows independently of weight values and char. Support S occurs in exactly (q-1)^|S| edge labels. For odd q the O'Brien–Voll orbit/character degree conversion gives ch(T,i;q)=q^(n-2i)[z^i] sum_S(q-1)^|S|z^nu(S). Root DP state mu-mu0 in {0,1} correctly yields P0=prod(P0_child+q P1_child) and P1=z(q^k prod(P0_child+P1_child)-P0). The tree DP and rank lemma constitute all-size proofs; packaged finite q=3,5 example code is only regression evidence.

value.rationale: Graphical groups are a natural open-ended enumerative family posed explicitly by Rossmann. The support-matching identity solves all trees, beyond paths, and the local two-state recurrence computes every character multiplicity without enumerating q^(n-1) edge labels. This is an extensible structural and algorithmic answer to an explicit question, not a tiny example.

limitations: Character counts asserted only for odd q, although weighted forest rank identity is field-independent; some rank lemma history may predate package.
